title: macOS Enterprise SSO App Extension (Extensible SSO for Apps & Browsers) via Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (macOS + Microsoft Intune/Entra; configuration/identity/security work, live-fleet care).
White-label; Apple/Microsoft console internals authored click-by-click from public docs; anything uncertain flagged, not invented.
hook: Stop the password prompts in Mac apps and browsers
problem: Users on managed Macs still get repeated sign-in prompts in apps and Safari because the Enterprise SSO app extension isn't deployed. This solution deploys the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in as an Apple Extensible SSO app extension via Intune — delivering silent, shared authentication to Entra-secured apps and browsers across the device (distinct from Platform SSO device login) — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how Apple's Extensible SSO (redirect/credential types) and the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in work for apps and browsers, and how this differs from Platform SSO device login.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Intune enrollment, Company Portal/Authenticator, Entra config, Safari/app support, a pilot group) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact steps to build the named Extensible SSO app-extension configuration profile, set app bundle IDs / URLs, deploy, validate silent SSO, then pilot and expand.
5 PowerShell scripts — SSO-extension discovery, per-device applied-state validation, an SSO coverage report, safe remediation of missing/mis-scoped profiles, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (extension active, apps/browsers SSO silently) plus Best Practices for app/URL scoping.
short: Deploy the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in as an Extensible SSO app extension via Intune — silent shared auth to Entra-secured apps and browsers on managed Macs (not device login) — pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Deploy the Microsoft Enterprise SSO plug-in as an Extensible SSO app extension via Intune — silent shared auth to Entra-secured apps and browsers on managed Macs (not device login) — pilot-first.
